title: The ABC Murders
author: Agatha Christie
summary: Poirot receives a taunting letter warning of a murder in a town beginning with A, followed by another letter and another crime. The killer seems to be working through the alphabet and a railway timetable.
readIf: you want a clever early take on the serial-killer mystery, in a classic puzzle form.
skipIf: you want graphic, psychological crime, as the tone remains polite and puzzle-focused.

pairings.reason: Another of her boldest plots, built around a killer with a plan and a pattern.
A modern forensic thriller that follows a killer who leaves deliberate clues for the investigators.
